items.clause: par. 72(1), table: rooms in residential buildings, min clear height 2.5 m
items.paraphrase: Habitable rooms in dwellings need at least 2.5 m clear height; attic rooms in houses may be 2.2 m.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2022/1225/text.pdf; attic rooms in single-family houses 2.2 m

items.clause: par. 75(1) (not par. 77): doors to rooms for permanent stay and kitchens, min clear width 0.8 m, height 2 m
items.paraphrase: Interior doors to habitable rooms and kitchens need 0.8 m clear width and 2 m height; clause number in pack should be par. 75(1).
items.note: read 2026-11-14: api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2022/1225/text.pdf; clause number corrected from par. 77 to par. 75(1); flat entrance doors are 0.9 m under par. 62(1)

items.clause: par. 75(2) (not par. 77): interior doors in public-use buildings, min 0.9 m clear width, 2 m height
items.paraphrase: In public-use buildings interior doors (except technical or utility rooms) need 0.9 m clear width and 2 m height.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2022/1225/text.pdf; technical and storage rooms excepted; applies to public-use buildings (office as typical case)

items.clause: par. 62(1), par. 75(2), par. 85(2)(3) (not par. 86): entrance and public-building doors 0.9 m; WC cabins adapted for disabled users 0.9 m
items.paraphrase: No dedicated accessible-door rule, but entrance doors, public-building interior doors and accessible WC cabin doors all need at least 0.9 m clear width.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2022/1225/text.pdf; no single accessible-door clause; 0.9 m is the common minimum for the doors disabled users must pass; par. 86 itself only requires threshold-free doors
read 2026-11-14: api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2022/1225/text.pdf; the law gives a 1.5 m square, not a circle diameter, so kept unverified as a proxy

items.clause: par. 70, table: pedestrian and wheelchair ramps rising over 0.5 m, max 6 % outdoors uncovered, 8 % indoors or under a roof
items.paraphrase: For ramps rising over 0.5 m the maximum gradient is 6 percent outdoors and 8 percent indoors or covered; shorter rises allow steeper slopes.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2022/1225/text.pdf; value 0.06 is the outdoor figure; indoor 0.08; rise up to 0.5 m: 8 % outdoors / 10 % indoors; up to 0.15 m: 15 %

items.clause: par. 60(1)-(3): at least 3 h sunlight on equinox days, 07:00-17:00 for habitable rooms; one room suffices in multi-room flats; city-centre infill may drop to 1.5 h
items.paraphrase: Habitable rooms need 3 hours of sun at the equinox within 07:00-17:00, only one room per multi-room flat; dense city centres may use 1.5 hours.

items.clause: par. 237(1) item 1, ZL zones: 40 m to an exit
items.note: read 2026-11-14: api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2022/1225/text.pdf (consolidated text 2022); act repealed 2026-09-21 (api.sejm.gov.pl/eli/acts/DU/2022/1225), no successor in force on 2026-11-14, still applies by declaration until 2028-03-20
